title: Valorant Teleporter
blurb: Bind is the Valorant map built around teleporters, and stepping into one makes a noise the entire enemy team can hear. That is the trade the whole map runs on: instant repositioning in exchange for announcing exactly where you are about to reappear. Entire strategies revolve around sending one player through as bait. The sound is a quick electronic whoosh with a hollow tail, and it triggers immediate paranoia in anybody who has played the map, which is the highest compliment a game sound effect can earn.
origin: The teleporter sound from Bind in Valorant.
